description: This file contains utility functions for formatting strings, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for use within a UI application. It provides functions to normalize string cases and delimiters to ensure consistent naming and display formatting.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace characters. Returns the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, handling delimiters, accented characters, apostrophes, and multiple spaces. Returns the original value if not a string.
